name: Stress Reconnect Churn
description: Request §36-38, §114: tens of disconnect / reconnect cycles during a running match. Every ${cycleSeconds} s, ${churnPercent}% of the players (a seeded pick) leave, half gracefully and half by a dropped connection (no disconnect packet; the server notices after DisconnectTimeoutMs, set to 2000 ms here so a cycle fits), and come back with the same DevPlayerId within the reconnect grace (10 s): the server must resume the same character (no duplicate player, no lost player), while everyone keeps walking. ${cycles} cycles; churnSeconds must be cycles x cycleSeconds (the measured phase covers them) and minCycles a little under cycles (--set cycles=10 --set churnSeconds=60 --set minCycles=8). A match (not DevRespawn): grace and resume exist only in a match; StartCountdownSeconds 8 lets every client join before it starts. The zone keeps running (it cannot be turned off in a match): it hurts players outside it from 45 s at 1 dps and from about 150 s at 2 dps, so the run stops churning at about 2 minutes, before anyone can die of it (a first 3-minute run lost 43 of 50 players to the zone in its last 30 s, and the dead came back as spectators instead of resuming). Everyone walks within 40 m of the centre. No hard limit (D42); judged on reconnect failures, duplicates, resumes and the steady numbers.
